summary_en: This phase II trial compares shorter-duration and longer-duration maintenance therapy with daratumumab in patients with light chain (AL) amyloidosis who received daratumumab as initial treatment. Daratumumab is given under the skin (subcutaneously) on day 1 of each 28-day cycle, for up to 6 cycles in one group or up to 18 cycles in the other, unless the disease gets worse or side effects are unacceptable. The trial aims to improve survival, but the specific primary outcome measure is not stated.
summary_es: Este ensayo de fase II compara una terapia de mantenimiento con daratumumab de menor duración con una de mayor duración, en pacientes con amiloidosis de cadenas ligeras (AL) que recibieron daratumumab como tratamiento inicial. El daratumumab se administra debajo de la piel (subcutáneo) el día 1 de cada ciclo de 28 días, hasta 6 ciclos en un grupo o hasta 18 ciclos en el otro, a menos que la enfermedad empeore o los efectos secundarios sean inaceptables. El ensayo busca mejorar la supervivencia, pero la medida específica del resultado principal no se indica.
who_for: AL amyloidosis confirmed by tissue testing with adequate typing.
Completed 6 cycles of daratumumab-CyBorD-based induction, or plans to before cycle 1.
Reached a hematologic response (complete, very good partial, or partial with a required level) after induction, as defined in the record.
ECOG performance status 0 to 3 and blood counts above listed minimums.
not_for: Pregnant or nursing, or able to have children and unwilling to use contraception.
More than one cycle of daratumumab maintenance before registration.
Multiple myeloma at diagnosis, as defined by listed criteria.
Immunocompromised, or HIV positive and on antiretroviral therapy; or uncontrolled illness or active infection.
